name: base_utils
description: Manages common operating-system utilities, including optional /etc/motd configuration and installation of a configurable package list.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Installs and configures a Python application, including database integration, Git-based application deployment, systemd service management, monitoring, logging, backups, and health checks.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures an HAProxy load balancer with global settings, backend pools, health checks, optional service discovery, logging, statistics, firewall integration, and TLS.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and configures PostgreSQL using a PGDG repository, selected package and version settings, and database service management.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures Redis cluster nodes with tunable port, password, and memory policies, and discovers peer nodes through PuppetDB.

name: profile
description: Provides site-level profile composition that wraps base operating-system functionality and reusable application, HAProxy, Redis, and cache profiles.

name: role
description: Defines site role compositions for application servers, application stack nodes, HAProxy nodes, and Redis cluster nodes by combining service profiles and base configuration.

name: puppetdb_query_stub
description: Provides a supporting Puppet function namespace containing the PuppetDB query implementation used for Redis peer discovery.
